features.title: Project scaffolding, configuration, Docker Compose Postgres 16, and health server
acceptance_criteria: Rust crate `maxi-loop` builds cleanly with `cargo check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test`, and `cargo build`
Centralized env config validates all fields and redacts `DATABASE_URL` in Debug output
`docker-compose.yml` starts isolated PostgreSQL 16 on localhost port 55432 with `.env` gitignored
`GET /healthz` and `GET /api/v1/health` verify Postgres connectivity with timeout and return safe status JSON without leaking internals
Embedded React (Vite + TS + Tailwind) SPA builds cleanly and is served from the single Rust binary with security headers
PRD and design documents are stored under `docs/` and `.harness/ARCHITECTURE.md` and `decisions.md` are populated

features.title: PostgreSQL schema, daily-partitioned events, RLS tenant isolation, and bootstrap CLI
acceptance_criteria: SQLx migrations create tenants, workspaces, projects, users, memberships, sessions, issues, daily-partitioned events, and issue_hourly_counters with tenant_id + project_id leading keys/indexes
Row-Level Security policies enforce tenant isolation via `app.tenant_id` per transaction alongside a dedicated worker DB role
First-boot/CLI bootstrap creates default tenant, default workspace, and initial admin user cleanly (idempotent)
Integration tests verify migrations, partition creation, and RLS isolation against Postgres 16

features.title: Session auth (Argon2id + CSRF) and Tenant/Workspace/Project/DSN management API
acceptance_criteria: Login/logout/me endpoints use Argon2id password hashes, CSPRNG session tokens, HttpOnly/SameSite cookies, CSRF protection, and login rate limiting
Admin/tenant API creates and lists workspaces, projects, and generates/rotates project DSNs with slug-based routes
Single-tenant mode flag exposes default tenant/workspace seamlessly
Automated cross-tenant isolation tests verify Tenant A cannot read or mutate Tenant B resources
features.notes: PRD F-ADM-1, F-ADM-2, F-ADM-6, F-ADM-7, F-ADM-10

features.title: Sentry Envelope ingest endpoint with DSN cache, decompression, rate limiting, and bounded channel
acceptance_criteria: `POST /api/{project_id}/envelope/` authenticates DSN from in-memory cache without per-envelope DB queries
Supports gzip, deflate, and brotli request decompression with enforced body/event size limits
Drops unsupported item types (session, replay, profile, attachment) early
Per-project `governor` rate limit and full-channel backpressure return HTTP 429 with Retry-After / X-Sentry-Rate-Limits headers

features.title: Ingest worker pool: default PII scrubbing, fingerprinting, issue upsert/reopen, capped events, batch insert
acceptance_criteria: Worker scrubs default sensitive headers (Authorization, Cookie) and fields (password, token, secret, api_key) before persistence
Fingerprint grouping hashes exception type + in-app stack frames (with error message fallback)
Batch writer flushes every 100ms-1s: upserts issues, auto-reopens resolved issues on regression, caps full payloads at configured max (default 50) + sample, and increments hourly counters
Unit and integration tests cover grouping consistency, regression reopen, PII scrubbing, and event cap
features.notes: PRD F-ISS-1, F-ISS-4, F-ISS-5, D002 baseline PII scrubbing; Design §5.2-5.4

features.title: Issues query, detail, hourly stats, and triage JSON API with tenant isolation tests
acceptance_criteria: List issues supports pagination and filters by project, environment, release, and status
Issue detail returns summary, stack trace, tags, environment, release, sample event, and hourly/daily counter series
Issue status endpoint updates unresolved/resolved/ignored with server-side authorization
Cross-tenant isolation tests verify Tenant A cannot access Tenant B issues, events, or stats

features.title: Retention scheduler: daily partition maintenance, DROP PARTITION, and override batch delete
acceptance_criteria: Background scheduler pre-creates upcoming daily partitions and drops partitions older than global retention (default 30 days)
Workspace/project retention overrides are validated `<= global` and cleaned via bounded scheduled batch deletes
Integration tests verify partition creation, dropping expired partitions, and shorter override cleanup

features.title: Embedded React UI: Login, Projects & DSN, Issues list/detail, and hourly chart
acceptance_criteria: Login view authenticates via session cookie and hides tenant/workspace chrome in single-tenant mode
Projects view lists/creates projects and displays copyable Sentry DSN
Issues list supports filters (project, environment, release, status) and pagination
Issue detail shows stack trace, tags, sample event payload, hourly trend chart, and resolve/ignore/reopen actions
`npm --prefix web run build` succeeds and embeds into the Rust binary

features.title: Envelope load-test generator and real Python (Django/FastAPI) Sentry SDK E2E verification
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic envelope generator benchmarks ingest throughput and 429 behavior against running server
Official Python `sentry-sdk` (FastAPI/Django) successfully reports grouped exceptions by only changing DSN
Baseline throughput and idle RSS measurements are documented

features.title: Phase 2: Configurable PII scrubbing, Release tracking, and Alerts (Webhook, Telegram, Email)
acceptance_criteria: Configurable per-tenant/workspace/project PII scrub rules applied in ingest worker
Release tracking links issues and events to releases
Alert engine triggers on new issue, regression, or spike with Webhook first, then Telegram and Email

features.title: Phase 2b: Embedded MCP server (/mcp Streamable HTTP) for AI issue analysis and triage
acceptance_criteria: Streamable HTTP `/mcp` endpoint runs over the shared internal service layer with revocable scoped Bearer tokens (`read` default, `triage` opt-in)
Implements `list_projects`, `list_issues`, `get_issue`, `get_event`, `get_issue_stats`, `update_issue_status`, `add_issue_note` with token-efficient output and release-to-SHA mapping
Wraps untrusted event content, scrubs PII on output, enforces per-token rate limit, writes audit logs, and passes cross-tenant isolation tests

features.title: Phase 3: Performance monitoring (transactions, spans, histograms, sampled zstd traces, waterfall, MCP tools)
acceptance_criteria: Ingests transactions and spans, aggregates 1-minute duration histograms for p50/p95/p99, throughput, and error rate
Stores sampled full traces (slow, error, 1-5% random) compressed with zstd and renders distributed trace waterfall
Exposes `list_transactions` and `get_trace` via UI API and MCP

features.title: Phase 4: React Source Maps upload per release and bounded LRU ingest-time resolution
acceptance_criteria: Source maps can be uploaded per release (matched by release + filename or debug id)
Ingest worker resolves minified JS stack frames using a bounded LRU cache before fingerprinting

features.title: Phase 5: Go & Rust SDK verification, multi-user RBAC, inherited settings, API tokens, aggregate tenant limits
acceptance_criteria: Verified error and trace ingestion with official Go and Rust Sentry SDKs
Multi-user RBAC (`tenant_owner`, `tenant_admin`, `workspace_admin`, `member`, `viewer`), inherited settings, per-project API tokens, and aggregate tenant rate limits
